Nemotron NVFP4 + general workload + CPU KV offload. Uses SimpleCPUOffloadConnector (the connector the vLLM Nemotron recipe prescribes), NOT the v0.26 OffloadingConnector used by exps 1-3: the latter asserts tokens_per_chunk %% tokens_per_block == 0, which crashes on this hybrid model's forced 2128-token attention block. SimpleCPUOffloadConnector has no block_size constraint. Pool = 10 GiB (cpu_bytes_to_use_per_rank), NOT the recipe's 220 GiB, because the vLLM pod is capped at 128 GiB RAM (220 would OOM-kill); 10 GiB still far exceeds the general workload's spillover. lazy_offload=false. Plus chunked prefill. max_model_len=8192 (matches exps 1-3) is REQUIRED for the offload test: with the model's native 1M ctx, vLLM's boot floor forces a >=1M-token cache (util>=0.364) that dwarfs the workload and never overflows; capping at 8192 lowers the floor so a small cache is legal. gpu_mem=0.345: the OffloadingConnector reserves a ~1 GB CUDA staging buffer, so non-KV memory is ~26.9 GiB (measured, offload ON) -> bootable floor is util~0.342, not the 0.325 that offload-OFF math suggested. At 0.345 the GPU cache is ~71k tokens: boots (8x above the 8192 seq floor) yet below the ~161k-token retained multi-turn set of all 45 general clients, so conversations overflow the cache and evict to CPU. Computed for THIS model (not borrowed from Qwen): weights+activation ~25.6 GiB leave a thin KV cushion of ~133k tokens (~4x one prefill batch, above the ~0.327 bootable floor). That is far smaller than the retained multi-turn KV of all 45 general clients (~160k+ tokens by ~5 turns), so accumulating conversations overflow the GPU cache and evict to the CPU pool, driving cpu_cache_usage > 0. Hybrid Mamba's tiny KV/token (~3 KB, only 6/52 layers hold attention KV) means offload can't be forced by shrinking cache alone the way it can for dense Qwen; the multi-turn retention is the eviction driver.

Multi-tier GPU->CPU->disk offload demo (Qwen3-14B, OffloadingConnector + TieringOffloadingSpec + fs secondary tier at /mnt/kv_cache emptyDir). SIZING (all boot- and spill-checked): gpu_mem=0.45 -> GPU KV ~6 GiB (~6-7 of the 6000-tok prefixes); CPU tier 2 GiB (~2 prefixes); GPU+CPU hold ~8-9. max_model_len=12288 is REQUIRED to boot (native 40960 would force a 6.25 GiB KV floor > the small GPU cache) and fits the multi-turn peak session ctx ~12000 (prefix 6000 + 6 accumulate rounds of q=400/out=600). WRITES/spill: 40-agent x 6000-tok working set (~37 GiB) is ~4.6x GPU+CPU -> GPU->CPU->disk write-through certain. READS/fetch (the point): agentic-multitier multi-turn (6 rounds, 20s think, accumulate, single_session) -> during each 20s think-gap ~240 requests run (12/s) touching all 40 agents, so a paused session's fixed 6000-tok prefix is evicted from the ~8-prefix cache before its next turn; round 1-5 re-attend the SAME prefix -> GPU miss + CPU miss + DISK HIT -> ~30k disk fetches (6000 sessions x 5 revisits). PROOF: vllm:kv_offload_tiering_read_bytes AND block_hits{tier=1:fs} > 0 (reads, not just writes). Needs pod volumes /mnt/kv_cache + /dev/shm + PYTHONHASHSEED=0 (blis-orc values.yaml).

NOT REPRODUCED (structural pipeline gaps, TODO): (1) MULTI-NODE DATA PARALLEL -- recipe uses --data-parallel-size 2 --data-parallel-size-local 1 --data-parallel-address $NODE0_IP --data-parallel-rpc-port 13345; the pipeline's single `dp` knob maps to BOTH data & dataLocal (single-node only) and has no coordinator address/port and multinode:false, so dp is set to 1 here and multi-node DP is deferred to a future pipeline feature. EXPERT PARALLEL: --enable-expert-parallel is carried EXPLICITLY in extra_vllm_args (not auto-derived): generate.py auto-emits it only when dp>1 AND model in MOE_MODELS, which is false at dp=1. When multi-node lands (dp>1), do NOT add Kimi-K3 to MOE_MODELS while this explicit arg remains, or --enable-expert-parallel would be emitted TWICE. Keep the explicit arg as the single source of truth across the dp=1->dp>1 transition. (2) NAMESPACE -- scc-gpu is namespace spartha-shared, but clusters.yaml has one global namespace (diya) applied to all exps; exp-14's generated PipelineRun will say namespace=diya and must be overridden to spartha-shared at run time. UNVERIFIED: 'moonshotai/Kimi-K3' model/repo (Moonshot's released model is Kimi K2), the vllm/vllm-openai:kimi-k3 image tag, and the 3 VLLM_* env vars + --moe-backend=marlin/--tool-call-parser=kimi_k3/--reasoning-parser=kimi_k3/--prefix-match-unit/--dcp-comm-backend recipe flags.
